reasons.claim: The chain runs Ibrahim b. Musa, Hisham b. Yusuf, Ibn Jurayj, Ibn Abi Mulayka, Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr, and the readers have all five, including Ibn Jurayj, whom the stored chain drops.
reasons.quote: أن ابن جريج، أخبرهم عن ابن أبي مليكة

reasons.claim: Abu Bakr and Umar speak only inside the story the last link tells, so neither is a link.
Ishaq heard the storyteller, who heard Abu Hurayra, so both are links after Ishaq.
The pointer to Hammad b. Salama's version writes no transmitters of its own, so it is a remark and not a route.
The chain ends with Ali, whose words Qays relates, and the stored chain omits him.
reasons.quote: عن قيس بن عباد، قال قال علي

reasons.claim: The description of Yusuf is a gloss and not a link.
The report names no transmitter before the saying, and the stored surface is not a name.
Musa b. Bakr relates from the source named by a title, who gives the answer and so is the last link.
reasons.quote: مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبْدِ اَلصَّالِحِ

reasons.claim: The readers keep Abu al-Abbas al-Madiri, whom the stored chain drops.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو العباس أحمد ابن إسحاق المادري

reasons.claim: Ali relates a dialogue between Fatima and the Prophet, so Ali is the last link and the Prophet ends the chain.
reasons.quote: عن علي بن أبي طالب (عليه السلام)، قال: قالت فاطمة

reasons.claim: The report is a saying with no transmitter.

reviews.question: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes («طرق») to a source, with no saying

reasons.claim: The route runs from the compiler's father through al-Himyari and Ibn Abi al-Khattab to Ibrahim b. Abi al-Bilad, and both readers' routes match it.
reasons.quote: رويته عن أبي- رحمه اللّه- عن عبد اللّه بن جعفر الحميريّ

reasons.claim: The kunya at the end is a gloss and not a link, so the reading would be right whichever way the owner rules on route statements; only whether to store it is open.

reviews.uncertainty_note: Reader B marks «أبي» as occurrence 1, which points inside «أبي البلاد»; the routes match, but that occurrence marker is wrong.

reasons.claim: Each link follows «عن» in order, and the Imam named in «سمعت» closes the chain.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع) يَقُولُ

reasons.claim: The brother is one link, his name alone.
After the two kinship links the text resumes at Abd Allah b. Amr, who is the last link; the stored chain merges him into «أبيه».
reasons.quote: حدثني أبي، عن أبيه، حتى ذكر عبد الله بن عمرو
